stages.title: Normalize the input
stages.desc: Counts the leading zeros of x with an AND chain over the inverted bits and encodes the count in five control qubits (q42..q46). CSWAP ladders controlled by those bits reverse/shift the x register into a normalized mantissa; the prefix flags and count bits are then erased by X-basis measurement with CZ phase repairs.

stages.title: Coefficient table lookup (256 addresses, busyaprime)
stages.desc: Reads the top 8 bits of the normalized mantissa (q14..q21) as an address and XORs the polynomial coefficient bits for that address into scratch qubits. This region is busyaprime's re-synthesis of mrmeows' lookup: 172 AND gates instead of 186, almost all of the rest CX, with HMR/R pairs recycling the monomial caches. It ends with the CX/SWAP relabelling of the lookup outputs that opened the next stage in mrmeows' file; the stage boundary is where the two op streams agree again.

stages.title: Early phase taps (coarse rotations)
stages.desc: Builds Boolean phase controls (exact gated quadratics of live coefficient bits) into qubits q59/q40, applies the 16 coarse Z_POW gates (2^-18..2^-3 turn, including the one T gate) plus Clifford fix-ups, and erases each control by HMR with feedback. Unchanged from mrmeows' design.

stages.title: Joint coefficient (front) decoder
stages.desc: mrmeows' frozen block that synthesizes the nine missing output directions of the coefficient decoder from the address, in the live physical wire frame. One window inside it (window S1) was re-synthesised by busyaprime: 25 AND gates instead of 30, so 33 Toffolis here instead of 38. CX-heavy, with 17 independent X-basis measurements whose phase kickback is repaired in the next stage.

stages.title: Front decoder phase repair
stages.desc: About 1,700 consecutive conditional CZ/Z gates (all conditioned on measurement bits) cancel the phase kickback of the front decoder measurements: a pure-Clifford phase-repair block of rank 256 over the address.

stages.title: Polynomial arithmetic, first block
stages.desc: First arithmetic segment after the decoder: dense Toffoli+HMR activity (about 90 Toffolis, 80 measurements) that begins combining the decoded coefficients with the low mantissa bits.

stages.title: Second CX-dominated block (lookup / history caches)
stages.desc: Another run of affine-form lookups with ~7 Toffolis per 250 ops, feeding the quadratic evaluation; consistent with the "history cache" idea of reusing earlier AND values through CNOT combinations.

stages.title: Polynomial arithmetic, second block
stages.desc: The main adder/multiplier region: ~25 Toffolis and ~25 measurement-repaired AND uncomputations per 250 ops, with 8 of the 11 classical BIT_STORE/BIT_INVERT ops (ops 25597-26075). Produces the bits that are streamed into the fine phase rotations.

stages.title: Fine phase rotations (streamed)
stages.desc: Streams the low output bits through a single control qubit (q40) with CSWAP and applies 26 Z_POW rotations from 2^-36 to 2^-11 turn, each followed by HMR feedback. Includes the one-Toffoli guard-bit phase correction F15 xor [Y1 and (e1 xor e2)].

stages.title: Phase merge repair
stages.desc: A ~850-op block of conditional CZ/Z gates right after the rotations that repairs the phase of the streamed control bits (the "partial-merge" correction tail).

stages.title: Late arithmetic with CCZ phase terms
stages.desc: Dense Toffoli/CCZ/HMR region (about 280 Toffolis) with many X gates and nested PUSH/POP_CONDITION blocks; the measurement-conditioned non-Clifford corrections of the arithmetic live here.

stages.title: Third CX-dominated block
stages.desc: Another long affine-form block (about 60 Toffolis) preparing inputs for the late curvature/normalization stage.

stages.title: Late curvature and normalization stream
stages.desc: Recycles caches with HMR+R pairs and runs the late curvature products and sequential normalization decoder before the final phase-retirement stage.

stages.title: Retained-seed phase retirement
stages.desc: A single 7,000-op pure Clifford block (CZ/Z/NEG conditioned on measurement bits) that retires the ten retained derivative seed bits and the pending address-dependent sign phases as sums of NEG, Z and CZ terms (quadratic truth-table rank 256).

stages.title: Seven parity-product helpers
stages.desc: Seven tailored AND helpers (7 Toffolis) give the exact retirement order for all ten seeds with Clifford-only repairs, then are erased.

stages.title: Seed retirement, remaining phase terms
stages.desc: Continuation of the Clifford phase retirement (another 1,250-op CZ/Z run) followed by CX frame restoration of the raw address wires.

stages.title: Normalization unwind (gray-prefix decoder)
stages.desc: Rebuilds the leading-zero prefix flags from the retained count bits (two low bits measured in a Gray basis, higher bits turned into prefixes with CNOTs), uses them to run the CSWAP ladders backwards so x returns to q0..q21, then resets the last scratch qubits. The 10.5-Toffoli mean decoder sits at ops ~45175-45537.

groups.name: x_reg
groups.role: input register "x" (little endian); holds the normalized mantissa mid-circuit, restored at the end

groups.name: x_lo
groups.role: low 14 mantissa bits, untouched through the front decoder
groups.evidence: documented (mrmeows' front-decoder interface: the low mantissa wires are untouched)

groups.name: addr
groups.role: top 8 bits of normalized mantissa = 8-bit coefficient-table address (256 entries)
groups.evidence: documented (truth tables on wires 14..19; 256 raw addresses)

groups.name: norm_ctrl
groups.evidence: inferred from op stream; documented as normalization outcomes/count bits

groups.name: norm_flags
groups.role: leading-zero prefix AND chain and an odd-shift flag (q22); erased by HMR in stage 0

groups.name: scratch
groups.role: all 41 non-input wires: coefficient bits, monomial caches, products, derivative seeds, phase controls; reused many times. There is no persistent output register: the result is the phase
groups.evidence: verifier contract (all non-x qubits scratch) + op stream

groups.name: phase_ctrl
groups.role: streamed phase-control qubits: q59 for the coarse pass, q40 for the fine pass
groups.evidence: documented q40 (physical_streamed_phase_bit); q59 from Z_POW targets

groups.name: retained_seeds
groups.role: ten retained derivative seed bits at the seed-phase-retirement stage

groups.name: raw_copy
groups.role: the eight raw-address copies kept at the seed-phase entry

groups.name: guard_exp
groups.role: guard bit Y1 (q52) and exponent bits e1,e2 (q56,q14) used by the guard-bit phase correction
